title: Chapter 424 God Star Way
content:
Chapter 424 God Star Way

But looking at the behavior of that Taoist priest now, he is too presumptuous. He doesn't pay attention to the secular dynasty at all, and really regards himself as a superior fairy.

This situation must be stopped, to prevent those cultivators from understanding the majesty of the court's laws, God knows when they dare to kill officials and rebel, and even help the enemies of the empire against the empire just because of a moment of righteous indignation.

"Take down this monster for me, and send it to the government for punishment." Zhong Yu said to Gai Nie and others beside him.

When Gai Nie heard this, he immediately made a move, intending to take down the Taoist priest.

The Taoist priest on the opposite side saw Zhong Yu's behavior as a government official just now, and he had already identified him as an imperial eagle dog, and now he was going to arrest him and send him to the government, which was even more certain.

However, it is not so easy to catch him. He is the elder of the local sect of Annan Province, Shen Xingdao. Looking for the bad luck of Yuguo, after raging for a while, he left in the air, mocking Yuguo's laws as useless.

As for the confidence and capital to do so, he himself has reached the cultivation level of a sixth-tier celestial master, which is the basis for all his actions.

This Taoist priest has this self-confidence. With his sixth-level strength, let alone breaking into the imperial capital, even sneaking into the palace and wreaking havoc, he can retreat completely.

According to his past experience, the secular dynasties in various places often have no mandatory constraints on a strong man of his level. Even if these powerful people do some outrageous things, they will be wiped away by the secular dynasty to wipe out their future troubles.

The current Yuguo seems to have a very ruthless policy, which seems to cover all practitioners. But since it was introduced, the only ones restricted are ordinary people of the third and fourth ranks, and there are very few powerhouses of the fifth rank, and none of the sixth ranks.

This made the Taoist priest take it for granted that Yuguo was just talking on the surface, and he didn't really want to target practitioners like them. After all, the power of a cultivator is too powerful, far beyond what a small secular dynasty can resist.

The purpose of introducing this kind of policy this time is to take advantage of the power of the policy to clean up the thorns in some places, so as to stabilize the foundation of the imperial court and establish some majesty by the way.

However, even so, I am still a little dissatisfied. After all, this order has greatly damaged the dignity of their outsiders in a certain sense.

That's why he wanted to come to this imperial capital to make a fuss, and severely hit the majesty of this small country that has just risen, so that he can understand who is the one who really holds power.

However, all of the above were nothing more than Taoist priests took it for granted before coming to the imperial capital. He clearly felt threatened when Gai Nie made a move.

This kind of aura, this kind of power fluctuation, is definitely the strength of a sixth-order celestial master, and the cultivation base of a martial sage in martial arts.

"Am I crazy? Or has the world changed, how can you meet a strong man of the same level to stop you if you use Taoism casually?" The Taoist thought in his heart, feeling extremely bitter.

But he didn't panic either. After all, he is also a sixth-level celestial master, and his cultivation level is the same as that of the person opposite. In a real fight, it is not certain who will lose.

Gai Nie went up and wrestled with the Taoist priest, in which Dao techniques flashed continuously, and Gai Nie's super martial arts were also constantly used, endless lights flashed, bringing out Taoist splendor, which was very beautiful.

Zhong Yu on the periphery watched Gai Nie entangle with the Taoist priest, the two seemed to be on equal footing in the fight, even Gai Nie was a little bit at a disadvantage because of the short breakthrough time, so he couldn't help feeling a little anxious.

"My lord Donghuang, go up and help Gai Nie, quickly take down this demon way, I don't have so much time to spend here." Zhong Yu said to Donghuang Taiyi beside him.

"Yes." After receiving the order, Donghuang Tai moved his body and stepped into the battlefield in an instant. With a slap, he attacked the Taoist priest.

As the head of the Yin-Yang family, Donghuang Taiyi is extremely skilled in Yin-Yang techniques, and because the Yin-Yang family's cultivation system has the meaning of being a fellow practitioner of martial arts and martial arts, his combat power is also top-notch among the same rank, which is extremely powerful.

At this time, taking advantage of the opportunity when the Taoist priest was entangled with Gai Nie, and all his energy was dragged down, he seized the opportunity and attacked the Taoist priest.

The Taoist slashed Dong Huangtai one by one behind his back, and a strange yin and yang power was transmitted, and the power spread to the whole body along the contact port, and his body was eroded and controlled all at once, and he could not use any power.

But this is nothing, as Taoist monks, what they cultivate is the soul, and the body is only used to protect the way, and they can be discarded and replaced at any time.

In front of him, even though his physical strength has been crippled, his soul can leave his body at any time and escape to other places to retake it.

Even if there is no body, the soul of the Taoist priest can better absorb the aura of heaven and earth, and the power of the Taoism displayed is stronger, but if you are injured at this time, it is extremely difficult to heal the injury on the soul, and ordinary people will not Consider it.

Just when he wanted to get out of his body and escape from this place, and then seek revenge after reincarnating. But he was shocked to find that his spirit had been trapped in his body, and he couldn't escape.

Moreover, the yin and yang power of his body is constantly eroding his soul through the medium of his body, making the soul become filthy and begin to weaken.

The human soul is an extremely pure thing, which cannot bear the slightest bit of filth, but the soul of a monk is even purer, and the more he cultivates, the more crystal clear, without any dust.

If a person's soul is polluted, then either his soul will be scattered, or he will be a complete demon, and he will lose his heart and have no chance of reincarnation.

That's because now that the soul is murdered, he can't use his mana at all, and he can't even control his life, and let others take it.

Donghuang Taiyi stepped forward, mentioned the Taoist priest, and threw it in front of Zhong Yu, and said, "I have fulfilled my mission and captured the demon way, please forgive me."

Zhong Yu looked at the Yao Dao in front of him, his hair was disheveled, and his Taoist uniform was already in tatters, but now it is even worse. His eyes are bloodshot, his lips are blue, and his skin is black. It was formed by backlash after being eroded by Yin Yang Art of.

"You...you can't kill me. I am an elder of Shenxingdao. I will let it go, and when the time comes, your little mortal dynasty will definitely be destroyed." The eyes of the monster were full of fear, and it was obvious that he had a little prediction about how he would be treated next, so he hurriedly walked out of the backstage and said threateningly .
